# Contributing

Thanks for wanting to help with VNext!

- **Something doesn't work?** Open an issue with the [bug report form](https://github.com/zsande/VNext/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). A small game that shows the problem helps most.
- **A question?** Ask in [Q&A](https://github.com/zsande/VNext/discussions/categories/q-a).
- **An idea?** Suggest it in [Ideas](https://github.com/zsande/VNext/discussions/categories/ideas), and say what you want to make with it.
- **Made something with VNext?** Show it in [Show and tell](https://github.com/zsande/VNext/discussions/categories/show-and-tell).

## Pull requests

As the README's [How it's made](https://github.com/zsande/VNext#how-its-made) says, VNext's code is written by Claude, and I review, test and commit every change. Pull requests are welcome all the same:

- For anything bigger than a small fix, open an issue or an idea first, so we can agree on it before you spend time on it.
- One change a pull request, in VNext's style: plain English in everything players and game makers read, settings that work without being set, and no new libraries without asking first.
- Build it ([Building from source](https://github.com/zsande/VNext#building-from-source) says how) and say how you tested it.

By sending a pull request, you agree that your change is shared under VNext's [zlib licence](https://github.com/zsande/VNext/blob/main/LICENCE.txt).

Please follow the [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
